description: Find any SuliHuli page by words: editorial answers to everyday EV questions - home charging (installing a charger, slow or failed charging), battery care (charging to 80 or 100 %, LFP vs NMC), winter range, running cost, buying on a budget - guides (running cost, winter range, upcoming EVs, value map, cheat sheet), rankings, brands, incentives per country, models, the ranking method, sources, legal and trust pages. Use it for questions a page answers, e.g. 'which EVs have a third row', 'how long to install a home charger' or 'why is my EV charging slowly at home', before answering such a question from general knowledge; read a result whole with fetch. Returns id, title, url, kind and a short excerpt per page. For numbers, filters and rankings of models use search_models.

kind.description: Optional: only pages of this kind.

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

query.description: Words of the question or the page, any order, e.g. 'home charger install time', 'germany grant', 'methodology'.
